entries.question: Hlo mujhe apna admit Card download karna hai
entries.answer:
नमस्ते। अपने प्रवेश पत्र (Admit Card) को डाउनलोड करने के लिए, कृपया KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर जाएं।

वहाँ आप **'Examination'** अनुभाग के अंतर्गत **'Entrance Examination Registration Portal'** ([https://kgmu.org/examportal.php](https://kgmu.org/examportal.php)) पर जाकर अपने क्रेडेंशियल्स (लॉगिन विवरण) का उपयोग करके अपना प्रवेश पत्र प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

यदि आपको कोई विशिष्ट समस्या आ रही है, तो कृपया बताएं कि आप किस परीक्षा के लिए प्रवेश पत्र ढूंढ रहे हैं।

entries.question: Kya kgmu me navaratri ki holiday hogi
entries.answer:
KGMU ke holiday calendar 2026 ke anusar, Navratri ke liye koi alag se gazetted holiday list mein nahi hai. Halanki, Dussehra (Mahanavami/Vijayadashami) ke liye 20 October 2026 ko gazetted holiday hai.

Kripya dhyan dein:
*   **Emergency Services:** Emergency services 24/7 chalti rahengi.
*   **OPD/OT:** General holidays ke din OPD aur OT band rehte hain.
*   **Teaching/Non-teaching Staff:** Emergency duty par maujood staff ko report karna hota hai.

Aap apne vibhag (department) ke office ya official notice board se confirm kar sakte hain, kyunki vibhagiya aadesh vibhinn ho sakte hain.

entries.question: How can I take appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online:** Visit the official portal at [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in).
*   **Phone:** Call the appointment helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
*   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT <YOUR NAME>" to **8887019134**.

**Important Instructions:**
*   **Online registration is mandatory** for all patients.
*   Please ensure you bring a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS when you visit.
*   Make sure to arrive at the hospital on your scheduled date and time.

*Disclaimer: I am an AI assistant and not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline for medical concerns. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.*

Aap niche diye gaye links par bhi latest notices dekh sakte hain:
* **Career Section:** [https://kgmu.org/job.php](https://kgmu.org/job.php)
* **Notice Board:** [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)

entries.question: apr 3, 2026 Exam centre
entries.answer:

On General Holidays, all OPD and OT services are closed, and no classes are held. 

Regarding your specific query about an examination centre, please note:
1. **Official Notices:** Examination schedules and centre allotments are published via official notices on the university website. Please check the **[Examination Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/exam_notice.php)** or the **[Examination Scheme page](https://kgmu.org/exam_scheme.php)** for the most accurate information.
2. **Clarification:** If you have received an admit card or a specific notification for an exam on that date, please follow the instructions printed on your admit card, as emergency services and certain academic activities may occasionally be scheduled differently. 

If you are a student, I recommend contacting the **Controller of Examination's office** directly if you do not see a notice regarding your specific examination centre:
* **Controller of Examination Office:** 0522–2980514
* **Email:** coe@kgmcindia.edu
